privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How your information is collected, used and protected.
privacy.intro: Nur Ta’lim Learning Center handles personal data carefully when you use our website. This policy explains what information we collect, why we use it and what rights you have.
privacy.dataText: When you enroll or submit the contact form, we receive your first name, last name, phone number, email, selected course, group and optional comments. Technical information such as browser type and page-view time may be collected for security and service improvement.
privacy.purposeText: We use your information to review applications, contact you, confirm groups and schedules, improve our services and meet legal requirements. We do not sell your personal data to third parties for advertising.
privacy.securityText: Data is stored in protected systems with restricted access. Only authorised staff can work with applications and messages. We do not keep personal data longer than necessary.
privacy.cookiesText: The website uses secure browser cookies and local storage to remember preferences such as language and theme. This information is not used to identify you.
privacy.rightsText: You may request access to, correction of or deletion of your personal data, and withdraw consent at any time. Contact us using the channels below to make a request.
privacy.consentText: By submitting a form, you consent to the processing of the information you provide solely for contacting you and reviewing your application. You may withdraw this consent at any time.
privacy.contactText: Send privacy questions to us by phone or email.
